name: Pressure Washer
bestFor: Cleaning patios, driveways, decks, and outdoor walls
safety: Wear eye protection and keep the spray away from people, pets, and electrical outlets.
description: A pressure washer helps remove dirt, algae, and stains from hard outdoor surfaces during summer maintenance.

name: Lawn Mower
bestFor: Cutting medium-sized lawns and keeping grass even
safety: Clear rocks and branches before mowing and keep hands away from the blade area.
description: A mower is useful for regular grass cutting when the lawn grows faster in warm weather.

name: Hedge Trimmer
bestFor: Shaping bushes, hedges, and small decorative shrubs
safety: Use gloves and keep the cord or battery clear of the cutting blade.
description: A hedge trimmer makes yard edges and bushes look cleaner with less effort than manual shears.

name: Extension Ladder
bestFor: Reaching gutters, walls, windows, and higher outdoor areas
safety: Place the ladder on stable ground and maintain three points of contact while climbing.
description: An extension ladder helps with safe access for short-term cleaning, painting, or repair tasks.

name: Cordless Drill
bestFor: Installing shelves, assembling outdoor furniture, and drilling pilot holes
safety: Use the correct bit and secure the material before drilling.
description: A cordless drill is a practical tool for many home repairs and quick installation projects.

name: Leaf Blower
bestFor: Clearing leaves, grass clippings, and light debris from outdoor areas
safety: Wear hearing protection and avoid blowing debris toward people or vehicles.
description: A blower speeds up outdoor cleanup after mowing, trimming, or patio maintenance.

name: Wet Dry Vacuum
bestFor: Cleaning garage dust, wet spills, and workshop debris
safety: Check the filter setup before vacuuming wet material.
description: A wet dry vacuum is useful for cleanup jobs that are too heavy for a regular household vacuum.

name: Paint Sprayer
bestFor: Painting fences, sheds, walls, and large outdoor surfaces
safety: Use a mask, protect nearby surfaces, and follow paint ventilation instructions.
description: A paint sprayer can cover large surfaces faster than a brush or roller when used carefully.

name: Tile Saw
bestFor: Cutting tile for patios, laundry rooms, bathrooms, and repair projects
safety: Wear eye protection and keep fingers away from the blade path.
description: A tile saw gives cleaner cuts for small renovation projects that require accurate tile edges.

name: Garden Tiller
bestFor: Preparing garden beds and loosening compacted soil
safety: Wear boots and keep bystanders away while the tines are moving.
description: A tiller helps prepare soil for planting or landscaping without buying large seasonal equipment.

name: String Trimmer
bestFor: Cutting grass around fences, edges, trees, and tight corners
safety: Wear long pants and eye protection because small debris can fly outward.
description: A string trimmer finishes the areas a mower cannot reach and improves the final yard appearance.

name: Circular Saw
bestFor: Cutting boards for decks, shelves, garden boxes, and simple repairs
safety: Clamp the material and wait for the blade to stop before setting the saw down.
description: A circular saw is useful for straight cuts in wood during short-term building or repair tasks.

name: Wheelbarrow
bestFor: Moving soil, mulch, plants, stones, and outdoor materials
safety: Do not overload the tray and lift with your legs to reduce strain.
description: A wheelbarrow reduces repeated carrying when moving heavy yard or garden materials.

name: High Airflow Fan
bestFor: Drying painted areas, garages, workshops, and cleaned surfaces
safety: Keep the fan on a dry surface and away from standing water.
description: A high airflow fan helps speed up drying and ventilation after cleaning or painting.

name: Portable Generator
bestFor: Temporary outdoor power for tools and project areas
safety: Use outdoors only and keep the generator far from doors, windows, and vents.
description: A portable generator provides temporary power when a project area does not have safe outlet access.
